description: List the thirty safety topics NASA ASRS Report Sets cover (runway incursions, CFIT, bird strikes, fatigue, icing, NMACs, and so on), each with its report count and when NASA last updated that topic's Report Set. Use before asrs_search to check whether a topic is covered at all and how current it is, so a search returning nothing can be told apart from a topic this pack does not track.
name: asrs_topics
title: Asrs Topics
